# Install manifest

Generated by `tools/build_template.py`. Do not edit by hand.

Install the **Registrar** first. It is the whole product on its own;
the companions are optional and can wait until you want them.

## Registrar

- Instructions: `dist/registrar/INSTRUCTIONS.md`
- Skills: `dist/registrar/SKILLS.md` (18 blocks)
- Routines: `dist/registrar/ROUTINES.md` (7)
- Connectors: Google Calendar (optional)

The Registrar's bundle includes the companion skills too, so a
solo install has every feature. If you later add the Tutor or
the Advocate, the Registrar hands that work over instead of
doing it itself — nothing needs removing.

## Tutor

- Instructions: `dist/tutor/INSTRUCTIONS.md`
- Skills: `dist/tutor/SKILLS.md` (4 blocks)
- Routines: `dist/tutor/ROUTINES.md` (1)
- Connectors: Google Drive (optional)

**Requires the Registrar.** Installed alone it has no Canvas
access and nothing to do.

## Advocate

- Instructions: `dist/advocate/INSTRUCTIONS.md`
- Skills: `dist/advocate/SKILLS.md` (6 blocks)
- Routines: none
- Connectors: Gmail (optional, drafts only), Google Drive (optional)

**Requires the Registrar.** Installed alone it has no Canvas
access and nothing to do.
